messages:
Nina: Heads-up team  we need a tight plan to deliver the new Cloud Onboard IAC Starter Pack for partner listings. Must-haves: Terraform module, minimal example, quickstart (3 cmds), CI smoke, listing assets, and a tiny ops playbook. Target: internal staging publish next Wednesday.
Oliver: I'll take the TF module skeleton + examples/basic and examples/complete. Will follow the modules/ examples/ tests/ layout and include provider pinning.
Jasmin: I'll own the quickstart + ref-arch doc and two diagrams (logical + ops). Will include a 'what to watch' section with SLOs and a short YAML for alerts.
Ryan: I'll wire GH Actions smoke workflow and add a matrix for x86/arm so Graviton issues show up early. Plan to run `terraform init` + `validate` + `fmt -check`.
Nina: Packaging constraints: listing blurb <=200 chars, icon 64x64 PNG, screenshots scrubbed of any customer data, include LICENSE and contributor guide. Also state minimum TF version.
Oliver: Adding `required_version = ">= 1.5"` in the module and a providers example in README. examples/basic will be tiny so CI can plan quickly.
Jasmin: Diagrams: I'll attach PNG + mermaid source and add a short quickstart with 3 commands: clone, tf init, tf apply (with minimal vars). Also include a short rollback note.
Ryan: CI snippet I'm going to add to the PR:
```
name: starterpack-smoke
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        arch: [x86, arm]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v2
      - run: terraform init -input=false
      - run: terraform validate
      - run: terraform fmt -check
```
Nina: Please also include a short compatibility table in README (aws/gcp regions, arch support, provider versions). I'll draft the marketplace blurb and icon guidance.
Oliver: I'll include examples/monitoring.md with a Datadog snippet and a note on swapping Prometheus operators.
Jasmin: Timeline: today owners set (done). Mon - PRs for module + README + assets draft. Tue - CI & pre-commit hooks. Wed - push to partner staging and run smoke window.
Ryan: I'll schedule a 30-min validation slot in partner staging Wed morning and tag partner-ops for a quick check.
partner-ops-bot: REMINDER: upload packaging assets to /partner-artifacts and run `./scripts/validate-listing.sh` to auto-verify metadata.
Nina: Who will sign off the alpha verification after staging? Need one person to do final check.
Ryan: I can do the sign-off if CI passes and staging smoke is green.
Oliver: I'll open the draft PR tonight and include a minimal examples/basic that CI can plan on.
Jasmin: I'll push diagrams + quickstart tonight and link them in the PR.
Nina: Great. I'll create the tracker ticket and assign tasks. Ping in thread if you need pairing. :thumbsup:
